name: Aquamorph
description: Variant humans adapted for aquatic environments. Aquamorphs can operate all standard equipment with minor alterations. Their STR is considered halved when operating out of water — a roleplay and referee-adjudicated penalty, not applied automatically by the engine.

traits.name: Aquatic Adaptation
traits.description: Aquamorphs gain DM+2 on all checks associated with swimming and do not suffer penalties that a normal human would when attempting tasks underwater. They can breathe underwater indefinitely and dive safely to 30 metres.

traits.name: Underwater Hearing
traits.description: Aquamorphs gain DM+2 to Recon checks when underwater. However, they suffer DM-2 on Recon checks when operating on land.

traits.name: Halved STR on Land
traits.description: When operating out of water, an Aquamorph's STR is considered to be halved for all purposes (lifting, melee damage, carrying capacity, etc.). This is a Referee-adjudicated penalty — the engine does not apply it automatically.

source: Traveller Aliens of Charted Space Volume 1, Mongoose Publishing
